title: docs(mcp): correct non-secret env destination for catalog installs
claim: mcp.md says non-secret catalog values go to ~/.hermes/.env; install_entry inlines them into config.yaml and .env holds only secrets.

evidence.red: website/docs/user-guide/features/mcp.md:122-123 on main: "writes the value to `~/.hermes/.env`. Non-secret values (base URLs) go to the same file."
evidence.green: 'Non-secret values (server URLs, OAuth client IDs) are not written to `.env`: Hermes inlines them into the server's `mcp_servers` block in `config.yaml`.'
evidence.negative_control: N/A for docs (no executable behaviour). Equivalent check: the stale phrase is present on main and absent on the bundle (grep given in red/green).
evidence.adjacent: python3 website/scripts/check_doc_links.py on the bundle tree: OK (no route-style links). All 7 B1 bundles cherry-pick together onto main cleanly, and each pairs cleanly with B2's current docs2-update/docs2-desktop/docs2-gateway/docs2-memory bundles.
evidence.source: hermes_cli/mcp_catalog.py:468-495 _prompt_env_vars saves only spec.secret values; :794-798 install_entry inlines `secret: false` values via _inline_non_secret_value (:498); surfaces mcp_picker.py:107 and web_routers/mcp.py:561 both call install_entry. optional-mcps/n8n-official/manifest.yaml:18 (server URL) and asana :30 (client id) are the secret: false values.
